# Versions of: The primitives of trust

1 published version of [The primitives of trust: why a web of trust between people works now when my earlier attempts at a key store did not, a site per person, keys made in browsers and in agent sessions, signing and following links done by an engine the user never sees, links that only count from the other side, kinds and provenance that can be confirmed, schemas each owner defines, and why it is easy to game one node and hard to game them all](../the-primitives-of-trust.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
